current_case.scope: Upper-ocean poleward Brazil branch14–38S reference corridor; exclude North Brazil, return flow and deep intermediate undercurrent. Southern confluence gate is editorial.
current_case.threshold_basis: Exploratory OSW signed-component contour diagnostics for the declared upper200m branch.10cm/s primary for the faster Brazil branch,5cm/s for the slower eastern-boundary branches; preserve all5/10/20cm/s same-node cases. These are not author-adopted physical current boundaries, density interfaces, uncertainty limits or one universal definition for all currents.
